verdict.rationale: Galileo's Python SDK/API and MCP server expose core workflows—creating traces, running experiments, managing datasets, and setting metrics (galileo-docs-2, galileo-docs-4, galileo-gh-1)—but the UI explicitly offers actions like one-click 'Create Experiment' buttons (galileo-docs-3) and alert configuration (galileo-docs-9/14) without documented API equivalents, and no public OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (galileo-probe-3), so full UI-API parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec proving complete endpoint coverage, and explicit API/SDK equivalents for alerting and other UI-only console features.
